crew.original_title: ドラゴンボール超 スーパーヒーロー
crew.overview: The Red Ribbon Army, an evil organization that was once destroyed by Goku in the past, has been reformed by a group of people who have created new and mightier Androids, Gamma 1 and Gamma 2, and seek vengeance against Goku and his family.
crew.title: Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero

also_known_as: やまかわ よしのぶ
details.biography: Yoshinobu Yamakawa is a Japanese director, animator, storyboard artist and character designer, known for his destinctive lovely pop character designs in Di Gi Charat, Akihabara Dennou-gumi: 2011 Nen no Natsuyasumi and Sweet Valerian. In 2008 he debuted as director for the feature film Hells Angels.
details.name: Yoshinobu Yamakawa
